---
description: gm_adjust_money as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
family: money
arguments:
  account: "The account."
  amount: "How much, in the world's main coin: above 0 puts money in, below 0 takes it out."
  source: "Where it comes from: from is prose, lore, author, gm, character, player, default or invented; lore, message and roll cite an entry, a message or a roll by id; an invention cites its gap_check and consent."
  precision: "How exact: exact, approximate, vague or unknown."
  standing: "How it stands: established, proposed or assumed."
---
Puts money into an account or takes it out against a correction, so the books show the balance the story gives. Taken past what the account holds, it is applied and reported. The books take nothing out of an account that is closed or otherwise not open. The answer says what changed and how the account now stands.
